fragments.js/sluice/340-jello.js: one refraction backdrop per frame: the region behind every visible lens is copied once, and each lens magnifies from the copy unless it reaches past it or overlaps a body already drawn
fragments.js/sluice/150-render-nightsky.js: the atmosphere raymarch renders once per time step into a texture; a scissored nearest-neighbour copy writes the rows the old in-shader horizon clip kept
fragments.js/sluice/046-shader-warm.js: the slime warm-up draws its bodies through the shared backdrop path

environment.note: A stand-in for Windows Chrome (Ganesh over ANGLE Direct3D 11). No Windows or PresentMon capture in this pass; the owner reports the stutter most clearly at 144 Hz and 2560 x 1440.

route.description: Key presses only: climbs of uneven length, glides, drops, short hops and reversals between the dev slime pen and the far end of the station deck, turning at either end and climbing no higher than about 28 tiles. Dev boot (the pen holds 8 slimes, 7 of them refracting), day clock running from time of day 0.5.
